description: The Symantec SymCrypt Cipher Engine is designed to provide FIPS140-2 algorithm support for the Symantec SymCrypt Cryptographic Module. This module supports Symantec Applications by providing validated and approved Cryptographic Services. The incorporation of these algorithms make these products ideal for enterprise and government applications.
